items.label: QUICK HOSE BIB FIX
items.value: Secure your outdoor faucet swiftly in 3 easy steps with this outdoor spigot repair kit. Whether it's a new install or an existing outside faucet, get it done with the Hose Bib Buddy. No plumbing required! Attractive and paintable.

items.label: RUST-PROOF & BUILT TO LAST
items.value: Crafted from durable aluminum, our outdoor spigot repair kit is designed to withstand the elements. Ensure your faucet and pipes stay protected from galvanic corrosion and remain in top condition for years to come. Made in the USA.

items.label: UNIVERSAL FIT FOR ALL SURFACES
items.value: From brick to cedar lapped siding, the Hose Bib Buddy is your go-to hose bib support. This faucet stabilization plate is designed to fit any flanged faucet, ensuring easy hand-tightening for even the most challenging mounts.

items.label: SOLID, WOBBLE-FREE & WINTER READY
items.value: Say goodbye to loose hose bibs and stripped screws. Hold freeze covers (including hose bib covers for winter styrofoam) tight all season with our patent-pending method, while preventing unwanted insects, moisture, and drafts from entering through the gap. Our kit ensures your outdoor faucet is both winter-ready and easy-access.

items.label: ALL-IN-ONE KIT
items.value: Our hose bib anchor comes with all essential hardware (plate, screws + clips). Finished with an antique brushed look, this faucet bracket and hose bib plate combo adds elegance to your outdoor spigot repair kit. *PATENTED* Patent# US 11,795,668. US Design D1,034,920 S.
